role: Defines the theatre every other component is scoped to.
decision: Use owens_valley ((-118.95, 36.55, -117.85, 37.75)) as the primary theatre, working in EPSG:32611 metres.
rationale: Sierra Nevada crest (>4200 m) to the west, White/Inyo Mountains (>4000 m) to the east, Owens Valley floor at ~1200 m. ~3.2 km of relief over ~30 km makes terrain masking a real mechanic. The box was sized to capture the real airfields along the valley (Bishop, Mammoth, Lone Pine, Independence) so start points and objectives are surveyed positions at surveyed elevations, not spawns inside a mountain. The AOI was accepted only after the true line-of-sight test confirmed a monotonic masking gradient with height above ground; a flat theatre would make the signature mechanic unlearnable no matter how good the policy is.
invariants: Cache keys embed the AOI bounds fingerprint; changing the box invalidates the DEM.
All env geometry is metric UTM; no per-step geodesy.

sources.name: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP)
